question: Which university faculty members' salaries are closest to the average salary for their respective ranks? Please provide the ranks, first names, last names, and salaries.university
sql:
WITH rank_avg AS (
  SELECT FacRank, AVG(FacSalary) AS avg_salary
  FROM university_faculty
  WHERE FacSalary IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY FacRank
),
rank_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    f.FacRank AS rank,
    f.FacFirstName AS first_name,
    f.FacLastName AS last_name,
    f.FacSalary AS salary,
    ABS(f.FacSalary - ra.avg_salary) AS diff_from_avg
  FROM university_faculty f
  JOIN rank_avg ra ON f.FacRank = ra.FacRank
  WHERE f.FacSalary IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT rank, first_name, last_name, salary
FROM rank_diff
WHERE diff_from_avg = (
  SELECT MIN(diff_from_avg) 
  FROM rank_diff rd2 
  WHERE rd2.rank = rank_diff.rank
)
ORDER BY rank, first_name, last_name
